description:
Ekadashi fasts, festivals and the appearance and disappearance days of the acharyas in the Gaudiya Vaishnava calendar, computed for one place. Call it for any question about when an Ekadashi or a festival falls, or when to break a fast.

The place is required and matters: the fast day is decided by the tithi at local sunrise, and the time to break the fast is minutes wide and different in every city. Ask the user where they are rather than guessing. Every observance links to a page with its story and the verses behind it.

days.description: How many days ahead, from today at the place. Default 30.

language.description: Preferred language of the translations returned. Not a filter: works that exist only in Russian are returned in Russian, and each result says which language it is actually in. Default: en.

name: get_vaishnava_calendar
title: Vaishnava calendar at a place
